note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/ui_audit.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so each task has at least one judge assertion it does not control.

evals.prompt: This landing page looks generic and AI-made. Restyle it so it looks designed, keep the content meaning, and save it as index.html in the output folder.
assertions: [script] ui_audit.py on the new index.html has verdict pass or review and zero FAIL findings
[script] ui_audit.py on the new index.html reports no tell-purple-gradient, tell-gradient-text, tell-emoji-icons or tell-filler-copy findings
[script] index.html contains a viewport meta with width=device-width and a :focus-visible rule
[script] the new file defines its sizes, spacing and colours as CSS custom properties (at least 8 var(-- uses)
[judge] The headline and button copy say what a workflow product does instead of stock phrases, without inventing features or numbers
[judge] The reply ends with Tokens, Audit, Left on purpose and Not checked lines, and says rendering was not checked unless a browser was used

evals.prompt: Here is my design tokens file. It feels off. Fix it so it is a sound system, explain each change in one line, and save the result as tokens.fixed.json.
assertions: [script] ui_audit.py on tokens.fixed.json has zero FAIL findings and no more than 2 WARN findings
[script] tokens.fixed.json has between 4 and 8 font_sizes, none below 12, and contains 16
[script] every spacing value in tokens.fixed.json is a multiple of 4 (2 and 6 tolerated)
[judge] The text colour and the on-primary colour keep recognisably the same hue as the original (they were adjusted for contrast, not replaced by unrelated colours)
[judge] Each change is explained in one line with the reason (contrast ratio, scale ratio, grid), and nothing is changed without mention
[judge] The reply states that tokens were audited with the script and what was not checked

evals.prompt: This signup form has no states. Add hover, focus, disabled, loading and inline error states and an empty-safe layout, keep it a single HTML file, save as signup.html.
assertions: [script] ui_audit.py on the new signup.html has zero FAIL findings and no focus-outline-removed finding
[script] ui_audit.py reports no states-error, states-loading, state-hover or state-focus finding
[script] signup.html contains aria-invalid and role="alert" (or aria-live)
[judge] Error copy says how to fix the problem (for example what format is expected), not only that something is wrong, and is placed beside the field
[judge] The submit button is disabled or shows a loading label while submitting, and the layout does not shift when it does
[judge] No new fonts, scripts or external resources were added
